## 0. Libraries and Setup

```{r}
# Libraries imports
library("BAS")
library("tidyr")
library("dplyr")
library("ggplot2")
library("rjags")

# Setup
set.seed(42) # for reproducibility
```

## 1. Data Analysis and Pre-processing

-   Name: Airline Customer satisfaction
-   Source : [Kaggle](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/raminhuseyn/airline-customer-satisfaction)

```{r}
# Loading the full dataset
data = read.csv("data/Airline_customer_satisfaction.csv")
data = data.frame(data)
cat(paste("Total number of rows :", dim(data)[1]))
```

```{r}
# Removing NA rows
data <- drop_na(data)
cat(paste("Total number of rows without NA :", dim(data)[1]))
```

```{r}
# Pre-processing the full dataset reducing it to 2000 rows
index = sample(1:nrow(data),2000,replace=F)
data = data[index,]
row.names(data) = 1:nrow(data)
data = data.frame(data)
cat(paste("Size of the reduced dataset: ",dim(data)[1],"x", dim(data)[2]))
```

```{r}
# Renaming columns with snake case
data <- data %>%
  rename(
    satisfaction = satisfaction,
    customer_type = Customer.Type,
    age = Age,
    type_of_travel = Type.of.Travel,
    class = Class,
    flight_distance = Flight.Distance,
    seat_comfort = Seat.comfort,
    departure_arrival_convenient = Departure.Arrival.time.convenient,
    food_and_drink = Food.and.drink,
    gate_location = Gate.location,
    inflight_wifi_service = Inflight.wifi.service,
    inflight_entertainment = Inflight.entertainment,
    online_support = Online.support,
    ease_of_online_booking = Ease.of.Online.booking,
    on_board_service = On.board.service,
    leg_room_service = Leg.room.service,
    baggage_handling = Baggage.handling,
    checkin_service = Checkin.service,
    cleanliness = Cleanliness,
    online_boarding = Online.boarding,
    departure_delay = Departure.Delay.in.Minutes,
    arrival_delay = Arrival.Delay.in.Minutes
  )
```

```{r}
# Looking at the unique values for categorical variables
cat("Unique values for satisfaction:\n", 
    paste(unique(data$satisfaction), collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
cat("Unique values for customer_type:\n",
    paste(unique(data$customer_type), collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
```

```{r}
# Handling Categorical Variables and creating dummy variables
to_numerical <- function(categorical, name){
  factor <- as.factor(categorical)
  cat(paste("Levels for", name, ":\n", paste("'", levels(factor),"' -> ", "[", 0:1, "]", sep="", collapse=", "), "\n\n"))
  return (as.numeric(factor) - 1) 
}

data$satisfaction <- to_numerical(data$satisfaction, "satisfaction")
data$customer_type <- to_numerical(data$customer_type, "customer_type")
data$type_of_travel <- to_numerical(data$type_of_travel, "type_of_travel")

## dummy variables dropping "Business" due to linear dependence
data$class_eco <- ifelse(data$class == "Eco", 1, 0)
data$class_eco_plus <- ifelse(data$class == "Eco Plus", 1, 0)
data$class <- NULL
cat("The column 'class' has been dummyfied to :\n class_eco, class_eco_plus")
```

```{r}
# Seeing Preprocessed Dataset
head(data)
```

```{r}
summary(data)
```


```{r}
# Split data 
train_test_split <- function(dataset, split_percentage){
  test_size = split_percentage * nrow(dataset)
  test_idxs = sample(1:nrow(dataset), test_size)
  test_set = dataset[test_idxs, ]
  train_set = dataset[-test_idxs, ]
  return (list(test = test_set, train = train_set))
}
```

```{r}
splitted_dataset <- train_test_split(data, 0.3)
dim(splitted_dataset$train)
dim(splitted_dataset$test)
```

```{r}
# Storing the train and test set
write.csv(splitted_dataset$test,"data/reduced_test.csv", row.names = F)
write.csv(splitted_dataset$train,"data/reduced_train.csv", row.names = F)
```

## 2. Variable Selection

```{r}
# Computing correlation 
cors <- cor(data)["satisfaction", ]
cors <- cors[names(cors) != "satisfaction"]

# Visualization
gradient <- scale_fill_gradientn(
  colors = c("darkblue", "lightsteelblue", "white", "orange", "darkred"),
  values = scales::rescale(c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1)),
  limits = c(-0.8, 0.8),
)

cors_df <- data.frame(
  variable = names(cors),
  correlation = cors
)

ggplot(cors_df, aes(x = variable, y = 1, fill = correlation)) +
  geom_tile() +
  gradient +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.title = element_blank())+
  labs(title = "Correlation with satisfaction")
```




```{r}
# Loading train and test set
data_test <- read.csv("data/reduced_test.csv")
data_train <- read.csv("data/reduced_train.csv")
splitted_dataset = list(test=data_test, train=data_train)
dim(splitted_dataset$train)
dim(splitted_dataset$test)
```

```{r}
# Model Selection on the covariates suggested by the professor
model <- bas.lm(satisfaction ~ age + seat_comfort + flight_distance + class_eco + class_eco_plus + departure_delay + arrival_delay, 
       data=splitted_dataset$train, 
       prior = "BIC",
       alpha = 1,
       modelprior = uniform())
```

```{r}
summary(model)
```

```{r}
image(model, cex.axis=0.7)
```

```{r}
# Model selection on all variables
full_model <- bas.lm(satisfaction ~ .,
       data=splitted_dataset$train,
       prior = "BIC",
       alpha = 1,
       modelprior = uniform())
```

```{r}
summary(full_model)
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
image(full_model, cex.axis=0.8, vlas=2)
```

```{r}
# Get predictions on the test set using BMA
preds <- predict(
  model,
  newdata = splitted_dataset$test,
  estimator = "BMA", 
  se.fit=TRUE 
) 

plot(splitted_dataset$test$seat_comfort, preds$fit, col="darkorange", xlab="Seat.comfort", ylab="satisfaction", ylim=c(-0.1,1.1))
points(splitted_dataset$test$seat_comfort, splitted_dataset$test$satisfaction, col="steelblue")
```

## 3. Bernoulli Regression using JAGS

$$
\begin{align*}
  & y_i \mid p_i \overset{ind}\sim \mathscr{B}e(p_i), &\qquad i=1,\ldots,n \\
  & \log\left(\frac{p_i}{1-p_i}\right) = \beta_0 + x_i \beta, &\qquad \rightarrow\text{logistic link} \\
  &\beta_j \overset{iid}\sim \mathscr{N}(0,100), &\qquad j=1,\ldots,p
\end{align*}
$$

```{r}
# Preparing the parameters
Y = as.numeric(
      splitted_dataset$train$satisfaction
    )

X = as.matrix(
      splitted_dataset$train %>% 
        select(age, seat_comfort, class_eco, class_eco_plus, arrival_delay)
    )
X = scale(X)

Xp = as.matrix(
      splitted_dataset$test %>% 
        select(age, seat_comfort, class_eco, class_eco_plus, arrival_delay)
     )
Xp = scale(Xp)

n = dim(X)[1] # number of samples in the training data set
npred = dim(Xp)[1] # number of samples in the test data set
par = dim(X)[2] # dimension on the linear model

data_list <- list(X=X, Y=Y, Xp=Xp, n=n, npred=npred, par=par)
```

```{r}
model_string = textConnection(
"model {
  # Likelihood
  for (i in 1:n) {
    Y[i] ~ dbern(p[i])
    logit(p[i]) = beta0 + X[i,] %*% beta
  }
  
  # Predictive 
  for (i in 1:npred){
    ypred[i] ~ dbern(ppred[i])
    logit(ppred[i]) <- beta0 + Xp[i,] %*% beta
  }
  
  # Prior
  beta0 ~ dnorm(0, 0.001)
  for (j in 1:par) {
    beta[j] ~ dnorm(0, 0.001)
  }
}")
```

```{r}
# Building the Jags Model
burn.in = 1000
n.iter = 2000
n.adapt = 200
thin = 10
n.chains = 1

model <- jags.model(model_string,
                    data=data_list,
                    n.chains=n.chains,
                    n.adapt=n.adapt)

update(model, n.iter=burn.in)
samples <- coda.samples(model,
                        variable.names=c("beta","beta0", "ypred"),
                        n.iter=n.iter,
                        thin=thin)
```

```{r}
for (i in 1:16) {
  plot(samples[,i])
}
```

```{r}
Ytrue = splitted_dataset$test %>% select(satisfaction)
Ytrue = Ytrue[,1]
Yrep = samples[[1]][,7:(length(Ytrue)+6)]
ppc_bars(Ytrue, Yrep) 
```

```{r}
ppc_error_hist(Ytrue, Yrep[100:101,],bins=3)
```
